decisions.reason: As a newly launched product line tightly linked to the core practice software and the firm's digitalisation path, it would likely be retained in 2019 because a growing firm with R&D and slack would tolerate early uncertainty absent clear signs of underperformance.

The continuing education institute builds on existing support and training capabilities, strengthens customer relationships, and for a growing established software firm there is no evident performance shortfall yet that would trigger dropping it so soon after launch.

The remote screen sharing support tool fits directly with the firm's support business and should improve service efficiency and customer value, so under bounded rationality it would likely be kept while management continues learning about its results.
